---
title: "Banner Image"
author: "Norah Jones"
title-block-banner: banner.png
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z, P5 bd-364ol5lu): a
# title-block-banner value naming an existing file (relative to the
# document) is an image banner — the generated include-in-header
# <style> sets background-image + background-size: cover (Q1's
# documentTitleIncludeInHeader behavior; banner.png is the committed
# 1x1 test image next to this fixture).
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "body > header#title-block-header div.quarto-title-banner",
            "main.content.quarto-banner-title-block",
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "background-image: url\\(banner\\.png\\);",
            "background-size: cover;",
          ]
        - []
---

Body.
